info-text: GeoPlay is a web-based game designed to test your geography knowledge. It covers every country in the world, whether the quiz focuses on flags, capitals, country codes, or other characteristics. This game is created primarily for Macondo (a project by HackClub).
games-info-text: We currently offer three main game modes. Each mode includes all countries and can be customized as needed. Additional game modes may be added in the future.
games-guess-the-flag-game-text: In the “Guess the Flag” game, you're shown a flag and asked to match it to the correct country. You'll be given a choice of several countries, one of which is the correct one for the flag.
games-guess-the-top-level-domain-text: In “Guess the Top-Level-Domain”, you need to match the country code to the correct country. For example, these codes appear at the end of a web address (www.xyz.us).
games-guess-the-capital-game-text: In “Guess the Capital,” you have to choose which country a capital city belongs to. It also works the other way around, where you have to match the capital city to its country.
games-settings-info-text: In the settings menu, you can adjust optional settings for your game here. If you change any settings, your score will not be counted toward the leaderboard.
